Who are we?

Tripledot Studios is one of the largest independent mobile games companies in the world.

We are a multi-award-winning organisation, with a global 2,500+ strong team across 12 studios.

Our expanded portfolio includes some of the biggest titles in mobile gaming, collectively reaching top chart positions around the world and engaging over 25 million daily active users.

Tripledot’s guiding principle is that when people love what they do, what they do will be loved by others.

We’re building a company we’re proud of. One filled with driven, incredibly smart and detail-orientated people, who LOVE making games.

Our ambition is to be the most successful games company in the world, and we’re just getting started.

The role is working within our studio: Belka Games

Belka Games is a game development company. According to Sensor Tower, the company is among the top 30 highest-grossing game developers in Europe, and its audience has recently surpassed 110 million players.

Role Overview

As a Marketing Creatives Producer, you'll have plenty of opportunity for research and complete responsibility for your project. Developing your own framework for analyzing creative content will allow you to create better content, and having a good relationship with partners will let you conduct extensive market research. If this challenge excites you and you want to join our amazing marketing team, make extremely effective, high-budget marketing content with us, get in touch.

Key Responsibilities

• Define and shape the creative strategy for one of our projects
• Set creative production priorities and contribute to planning
• Lead the creative development process end-to-end: generate hypotheses, select ideas, and oversee production
• Analyze creative performance and hypotheses, turning findings into actionable insights for the production team
• Improve creative analytics tools in collaboration with the Marketing Analytics team
• Monitor and analyze the mobile advertising market, trends, and best practices
• Maintain the Creative Knowledge Base and share relevant insights with the team
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams and external partners

Required Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

• Extensive experience in a similar role in GameDev, with a portfolio demonstrating successful creative production
• Deep understanding of the mobile gaming and mobile advertising market
• Strong knowledge of advertising channels, placements, and performance marketing
• Solid understanding of end-to-end art, video, and playable ad production
• Experience working with creative performance data and analytics
• Hands-on experience using AI tools and generative technologies in creative production workflows
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to generate, prioritize, and evaluate ideas
• Experience launching creative production for new games from scratch will be a plus

Working at Tripledot

• Hybrid Working
• 20 business days paid holiday in addition to bank holidays to relax and refresh throughout the year
• 20 business days remote working: Work from anywhere in the world, or use the time to cover mandatory office days to WFH, 20 days of the year
• Lunch: Provided daily in the office to keep you fueled and focused
• Continuous Professional Development: Propel your career with continuous opportunities for professional development.
• Private Medical Cover: Ensure your health is in good hands through private health insurance
• Sport Compensation: Stay fit and active with our sport compensation benefit
• Taxi to compensate for travel to the office
• English Classes: Enhance your English skills with our provided English classes
